scientific_integrity: Exact statements are proved by Ewens marked-cycle moments and rational factor comparisons; finite exhaustive enumeration corroborates but does not prove infinite-domain conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Factorial-moment ordering across different lengths, not association of all monotone functionals. Fixed-length asymptotics. Historical equivalence remains possible; independent historical-priority and proof audits have not been performed.
title: A sharp factorial-dependence transition and an equicovariance rigidity point in Ewens cycle counts
